title: A/R Summary: the CSV is one flat table with plain two-decimal amounts
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has open invoices on today's date of $1,250.50 that is 1 to 30 days past due and $99.00 that is more than 90 days past due, and nothing in the other buckets.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-18 Flat Table.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Summary is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Open the CSV in a plain text editor (not a spreadsheet program) and read the heading row.
  3. Find {Customer-A}'s row and read its cells.
  4. Read the last row.
  5. Look for any group header or subtotal row.
  6. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  7. Look at the PDF's last bucket heading.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the CSV downloads.
  • Step 2: the last bucket column is headed "91 And Over", exactly as the screen shows it.
  • Step 3: one row for {Customer-A}: 1-30 Days reads 1250.50 and 91 And Over reads 99.00 (no $ sign, no thousands comma, two decimals); Current, 31-60 Days and 61-90 Days are blank cells, not 0; the Total reads 1349.50 (1250.50 + 99.00).
  • Step 4: one Totals row at the bottom, and only one.
  • Step 5: there are none: every row except the Totals row is one customer.
  • Step 6: the PDF downloads.
  • Step 7: the PDF heading reads "91 And Over" on one line.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R7: “The A/R and A/P Summary PDF and CSV head the last bucket column "91 And Over", exactly as the screen shows it; in the PDF the heading stays on one line.”
  • S3-R8: “The CSV is one flat table: one row per customer or vendor (Summaries) or per document (Detail, Collection, Unpaid Invoices), with the aging bucket, customer or vendor in its own column; no group header or subtotal rows; one Totals row at the bottom. Money is a plain number with two decimals, and an empty bucket is a blank cell; dates are YYYY-MM-DD.”
